entry_state: The historical record now has explicit source-admission,rounding,information-view and dependency rules. A corrected interpretation changes eligible calculations while preserving the old explanation and committed events;posting a correction still needs accounting treatment. The literature chapter must now explain which established methods supply these capabilities and which design work remains.
exit_state: The literature supplies accounting algebra,incomplete-data semantics,provenance,inference,language and extraction components with explicit transfer limits. It leaves their integration and empirical merit unresolved. The architecture chapter must assign reusable components and project-specific responsibilities while keeping a typed-library alternative viable.
findings: The review names technical source anchors and distinguishes directly reusable concepts,adaptation and unsupported transfer. Unavailable originals are identified as bounded campaign omissions,not proof of global absence.
Certain answers are scoped to nonempty declared families;provenance edges are not probabilities. Identification,model averaging and interventions retain separate assumptions.

Typed libraries remain serious competitors to a DSL. Contract cash-flow semantics are not treated as complete accounting recognition rules,and rule conflicts are distinguished from probabilistic uncertainty.

TableFormer scores are tied to cropped-table/PDF-text conditions;question-answering and RAG evidence do not become whole-company forecasting validation. Solver and sampler capabilities remain bounded. No confirmed new defect in this author read;the underlying publications were not freshly re-audited here.
